memo:
EdgeHound Performance Review — 2026-06-23

Portfolio has declined 13.3% from inception (equity $8,673 vs $10,000 start) across 183 closed trades. The damage is concentrated in two engines now correctly disabled: MOMENTUM (-$1,019, 8W/21T = 38%) and SMART_CONSENSUS (-$385, 0W/1T). The surviving active lineup tells a very different story.

SHORT_FAVORITE on high-priced sports markets remains the fund's only validated edge: 79W/29L (73% win rate, 90% CI 66-80%) with a statistically robust n=108. This hypothesis is carrying the book. The engine's overall PnL of -$317 across 115 trades reflects legacy losses before tighter parameterization and some basis risk from non-sports markets where the edge is unproven (n=7, 56% win rate, CI too wide to act on).

VOLUME_SPIKE is modestly profitable (+$190, 8W/20T = 40% win rate). Win rate looks low but PnL is positive, suggesting favorable payoff asymmetry. Still sub-threshold for parameter changes.

ELITE_FOLLOW is marginally positive (+$82, 13W/26T = 50%). Wallet 'denizz' scores 0.8 and should be monitored for concentration. Wallet 'aenews2' at 44% win rate warrants watching for removal.

Open book looks clean: 8 positions, all SHORT_FAVORITE sports, small-to-mid sizing. Minnesota Twins ($500) and Kansas City Royals ($400) are notable concentrations but within maxEventExposure.

No parameter changes warranted this session. Current config (pMin 0.60, kellyMult 0.15, maxExposure 0.38) is appropriately conservative while the bot rebuilds from its validated edge. Resist the temptation to re-enable MOMENTUM — evidence remains strongly negative.

VOLUME_SPIKE: +$190 PnL despite only 40% win rate — payoff structure appears favorable; too few trades to adjust
ELITE_FOLLOW: marginally positive +$82, 50% win rate; wallet 'denizz' (score 0.8) is best-performing signal source
Wallet 'aenews2' at 44% posterior win rate (6W/8L) — below breakeven; candidate for disabling if trend continues
Open positions: 8 trades all SHORT_FAVORITE sports; MN Twins $500 and KC Royals $400 are largest open exposures
Brier score 0.235 is reasonable but not exceptional — model calibration has room to improve
No anomalous patterns in recent closed trades; recent SHORT_FAVORITE sports results predominantly positive
